references.text: Encourages doing good to others, which reflects Jesus' message in Mark 3:4 about doing good.
Focuses on keeping the Sabbath holy, which is relevant to the discussion in Mark 3:4 about what is permitted on the Sabbath.
Jesus asks a similar question about whether it is lawful to heal on the Sabbath, which directly relates to the question he asks in Mark 3:4.
Jesus challenges the Pharisees' understanding of the Sabbath by healing, which aligns with the theme in Mark 3:4.
Jesus justifies healing on the Sabbath, supporting his argument in Mark 3:4 about doing good.
Jesus speaks about fulfilling the law, which can be seen in light of his actions and questions in Mark 3:4.
